title: Unit tests: generator, lifecycle, network, IAM, rules, cost, time, what-if, boundary hardening
purpose: Unit-test evidence: seed reproducibility, lifecycle validation, reachability, IAM evaluation, detection rules, cost arithmetic, anomaly detection, what-if isolation.

title: Integration tests: simulator <-> database, engines <-> persisted history
purpose: Integration-testing evidence (simulator and database, optimistic locking, transactions, scan reconciliation).

title: API tests: auth, roles, validation, GET purity, audit, remediation, what-if, reports
purpose: API-level evidence: valid and invalid input, unauthorised calls, missing resources, duplicate operations, read-only GETs, what-if isolation, audit creation.

title: Regression tests: original CloudShield behaviour
purpose: Regression evidence: original authentication, mock provider, label-based engines, original API routes and persistence still behave as before.

title: Frontend integration contract tests
purpose: Every API call made by the UI exists in the backend OpenAPI document; every button/handler is wired.

title: Full suite on SQLite with coverage
purpose: Complete test run with line coverage of the application package.

title: Full suite on PostgreSQL 16
purpose: The same suite executed against a real PostgreSQL 16 server (TEST_DATABASE_URL).

title: Mutation testing summary (Cosmic Ray, two rounds)
purpose: Mutation-testing evidence: per-module killed/survived counts, round 1 (targeted tests) and final (after hardening tests).
